data.name: Arinjay
data.long_meaning: Arinjay is a Sanskrit name for a boy. Arin in Sanskrit means 'lightning'. The suffix -jay means 'conqueror'. Hence, Arinjay can be interpreted as 'one who conquers with the power of lightning'.
